title: Germany and its shadow
creator_credit: National Educational Television and Arthur Zegart
brief_description: An assessment of the New Germany ranging from the country from Hamburg in the north to the Bavarian town of Landsberg, where Hitler wrote “Mein Kampf”. With its re-awakening forces of German Nationalism, is there a danger of Germany again being led down the familiar path to war?
